summary: OpenAlex (CC0) is a second, copyright-clean data source exposed as the patch-added 'openalex search' command: live abstracts, author lists, citation counts, and OA flags for NEJM works filtered by ISSN 0028-4793.
reason: The Cloudflare-gated NEJM HTML transport cannot deliver abstracts, citation counts, or reliable author lists, and the spec's single-API model cannot express a second base_url, so the OpenAlex source ships as a hand-authored stdlib-HTTP command (net/http against api.openalex.org, polite-pool mailto) rather than a generated endpoint. A regen must re-add or preserve this command; it has no spec representation.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test green; live 'openalex search --query "vitamin D" --per-page 3 --sort cited --json' returns real NEJM works with reconstructed abstracts and citation counts (no 403). Command rides the MCP cobratree runtime mirror like the other novel commands, so mcp_tool_count/mcp_public_tool_count (typed endpoint tools only) are unchanged.
